changelog: Merged upstream 2.0.4/2.0.5 features: Home screen widgets (Chats, Quick actions, One chat, Scripts), Shizuku & Root device access modes, OpenCode model variants and effort controls, Terminal sessions drawer with IME paste fixes, and floating switcher overview.
Page overview: view active pages as cards, tap to open, hold and drag to reorder.
Preserved AntiGem Fork architecture: persistent WindowManager overlay with background touch pass-through, 8-way resizing & proportional aspect ratio lock, and Notes sync integrity.
